title: Design for Cancer Center Pharmacy Compounding Renovation
short_description: Design services for renovating and expanding a hospital cancer center pharmacy compounding area.
project_scope: Renovation and expansion of the second-floor Cancer Center pharmacy at SUNY Upstate Medical University to increase compounding capacity for growing patient demand. Scope includes review of the existing area, expansion of hazardous and non-hazardous compounding rooms, and upgrading cleanrooms to comply with new United States Pharmacopeia cleanroom standards while maintaining the current staffing level.
